Audio System Outline
A 6-speaker system combining the 05 model year HDD navigation (CD/MD type), non-standard size AM/FM electronic tuner with integrated in-dash CD changer or non-standard size AM/FM electronic tuner with integrated CD player with 6 speakers has been adopted.
A 6-speaker system is provided as a radio-less audio system.
All models adopt a foldable short pole antenna mounted at the rear end of the roof.
